alignments.note: Coordinating conjunction to the verse-opening And.
Substantival adjective, no article present; the plural noun is its own English word.
Finite verb to the lexical verb.
Preposition to into (rule 36).
First article takes the English determiner (rule 19); the ASV reorders the adjective in front of the noun but the determiner is still this article's.
Attributive adjective to good, bare of its determiner since the article takes it.
Noun to ground; the determiner stands on the article under rule 19, not here.
Second attributive article of the τὴν γῆν τὴν καλήν frame has no English realization (rule 23).
Expressed conjunction to and.
Imperfect to yielded; no auxiliary written.
Noun to fruit.
Compound participle: the preverb ἀνα- is realized by up, which rides inside the verb's own unit headed on the verb word growing (rule 106); no Greek preposition stands for up to answer to.
Expressed conjunction to and.
Participle to increasing.
Expressed conjunction to and.
Imperfect ἔφερεν to brought forth; forth is the English verb's own particle, no Greek preverb or preposition standing for it, and the head is the verb word (rule 17).
Distributive ἕν before the numeral has no English word: the ASV writes a bare thirtyfold. Aligning it to a supplied determiner was considered, but none stands here.
Numeral to thirtyfold; the -fold is part of the ASV's rendering of the bare numeral.
Expressed conjunction to and; this is not rule 29's supplied juncture, the Greek writing καί itself.
Second distributive ἕν has no English realization, as at s017 — one analysis for all three (rule 24).
Numeral to sixtyfold.
Expressed conjunction to and.

Third distributive ἕν left empty with s017 and s020. Reading the supplied a of a hundredfold as this token is defensible, but rule 29 already gives ἑκατόν → a hundred with the indefinite as the numeral's own helper, and taking it here would break the uniform treatment of the three ἕν tokens.
ἑκατόν takes a hundredfold whole, the supplied a being the numeral's ordinary helper under rules 7 and 29.

review_notes: Three distributive ἕν tokens are left unrepresented; a reference comparison will report them as disagreements.
τὴν γῆν τὴν καλήν: the first article takes the ASV's the even though the ASV reorders good in front of ground, and the second attributive article is unrepresented under rule 23.
ἀναβαίνοντα keeps up inside its own unit under rule 106, no preposition standing to answer to it; brought forth likewise stays whole on ἔφερεν.
Variant v013 is underdetermined over the ἕν/ἐν readings of the numeral series; the projection's base is aligned as given without a new textual decision (rule 12).
